note: Paint order per slot, using the layer roles of the template bank's layer contract (#311): bg, ground, mid, char, fx, texture, type (type always last, live text).

integration.grade: pull toward the slot's screen blue #18324A in the shadows and toward amber #F2A93B in the highlights; black point matched to the frame's void
integration.texture: CRT scanlines 3px period at 10-14% over the whole slot (multiply)
integration.never: no sticker outline, no drop shadow, no drawn mecha or people in code
